links.outcome: Reproducibility of answers on retesting all exam questions (Cohen Kappa, McNemar)
links.effect: GPT-o1 tended to correct previous mistakes on retesting, while GPT-4o and GPT-4o Mini more consistently repeated initial answers.
links.quote: The reproducibility analysis showed GPT-o1's tendency to correct previous mistakes on retesting, while GPT-4o and GPT-4o Mini more consistently repeated initial answers.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks OpenAI models (GPT-4o Mini, GPT-4o, GPT-o1) on Spanish pharmacy and biology residency examinations (FIR and BIR) to assess accuracy and reproducibility.
